verdict.rationale: First-party docs say you can select the phone button in your dot's ChatGPT conversation to start a call, and type while talking. A call is one of the channels that reaches the same dot without resetting its memory, so it offers live voice conversation. Missing for 10: detail on latency and turn-taking (the 'natural, real-time' quality), voice options and supported surfaces beyond ChatGPT, and independent or hands-on corroboration of call quality.
